Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

coincidence — two things happening together by chance. Example: It was a strange coincidence.
strange — unusual, not normal. Example: It is a strange story.
happen — to take place. Example: What happened?
meet — to come together with someone. Example: I met an old friend.
find — to see something you were looking for. Example: I found my keys.
lose — to not be able to find something. Example: I lost my keys.
same — not different. Example: We were in the same shop.
surprise — an unexpected event. Example: What a surprise!
remember — to keep something in your mind. Example: I remember it well.
accident — something bad that happens by chance. Example: It was an accident.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What happened?
• It was a coincidence.
• I found ... in the same ...
• What a surprise!
• I remember it well.
